content:
By on September 8, 2026 4:16 PM

Dallas, TX —- Craft beer and bar pioneers, Flying Saucer Draught Emporium, located on the breezy banks of Lake Ray Hubbard celebrate Oktoberfest with the annual “Laketoberfest” celebration on Sunday, October 4th beginning at 11am. 

Festivities include tastings from a bevy of traditional, local, national and international Oktoberfest brews from the likes of Toppling Goliath, Real Ale, Hacker-Pschorr, Turning Point and Sierra Nevada. Tasting cards can be purchased at the restaurant on Sunday for $25 and includes (6) flight-size pours. The annual stein hoisting competition begins at 3pm.

Bavarian food specials include Jaegerschnitel with German potato salad, Sheboygan sandwiches, pretzels, brats and apple fritters in addition to the popular menu offerings.

Flying Saucer Draught Emporium is a neighborhood pub built around great food, and more than 30 years of beer culture. Inspired by the convivial spirit of European pubs, Flying Saucer is known for an extensive rotating selection of more than 200 craft beers, alongside craft cocktails and a full bar. Weekly trivia, local teams on the big screens, and the legendary UFO Club.

Lakeside patio, indoor dining and beer to-go, Flying Saucer is located at 4821 Bass Pro Drive on Lake Ray Hubbard. Flying Saucer is open daily from 11am-12am. For more information go to www.Beerknurd.com or call 972-226-0725. Flying Saucer has 11 locations across Texas and the Southeast, including Dallas-Fort Worth, Houston, San Antonio, Little Rock, Memphis, Charlotte and Raleigh.
